# P26.13 — Open-data-catalog sweep: systematic camreg discovery (SOURCES.12)

Turns P26.9's hand-picked camera-registry coverage into **systematic catalog
discovery**: enumerate surveillance-relevant datasets through the Socrata,
ArcGIS Hub, and CKAN/DCAT catalog APIs, qualify every candidate honestly
(registry-shaped vs non-target vs gated vs probe-error), and wire the
verbatim-clear registries through the existing `dot_511` / `socrata_rows`
path — camera **registry records only**: no image/video/feed/HLS/still
content, no person data, no plate reads.

## What landed

- **`docs/build/tools/catalog_sweep.py` + three committed artifacts**
  (`reports/catalog_sweep_2026-09-18{,_qualified,_reviewed}.json`) —
  **3,257 candidates** enumerated across three catalog APIs (Socrata catalog
  v1, ArcGIS Hub search v1, CKAN `data.gov.uk` — `catalog.data.gov` 404
  recorded), far past the ≥50-candidate / ≥2-API floor. The review pass
  reclassified the keyword false-positive families — epidemiological
  "surveillance", violation statistics, ALPR *read* feeds — as `non_target`
  with reasons; probe errors (DNS/SSL/503/no-layer) are preserved as `error`,
  never dropped:

  | verdict | rows |
  |---|---|
  | camera_registry-shaped | 278 |
  | — verbatim-clear licence | 21 |
  | — gated (no clear grant) | 257 |
  | probe error | 68 |
  | non_target | 2,911 |

- **10 registries wired + flipped under GL-GATE-06**, each with a rights
  packet quoting the terms verbatim (`reports/rights/camreg_*.md`):
  Washington DC + Gold Coast (CC-BY-4.0 → `sig_graph`); Nottingham, York,
  Glasgow, North Ayrshire, Lambeth (OGL-3.0 → `ogl_uk3`); Peel
  (LicenseRef-Peel-ODL-1.0, Wayback-captured grant → new `peel_odl1`
  compartment); Rochester (ODbL-1.0 → `osm_physical`, kept separate);
  Puerto Gaitán (CC-BY-SA-4.0 → `portal`, kept separate).
- **`camreg_stalbert_ab` stays gated** — its licence *name* was observed but
  the grant text could not be captured verbatim (`data.stalbert.ca` licence
  page is a JS-rendered shell; not Hub-searchable; no Wayback). Reverted to
  `UNDETERMINED`; named individually in **D-SOURCES.12-1** alongside the 257
  gated rows + 68 error rows as the reviewer worklist.
- **Registry wiring** — `camera_registry_targets.toml` +11 rows;
  `sources.toml` +11 (187 → **198** registered, 66 → **76** loadable);
  `live_targets.toml` +11 (76 → **87**); `runner.py` maps all 11 to
  `dot_511`; `api_allowlist.toml` gains the new hosts with terms basis.
- **`dot_511_vocab.toml` → `2026.09.18.2`** — observed aliases for the UK
  CCTV schemas (`CAMERA_ID`/`CCTV_NUMBER`/`SITE_ID`/`WARD`/`DIVISION`), Peel
  (`CAMERA_NUM`/`Street`/`StrInt1`/`StrInt2`/`MUN`), DC (`ADDRESS`/`PSA`/
  `STATUS`), Gold Coast (`NAME`), Puerto Gaitán (`latitud`/`longitud`/
  `georeferencia`/`nombre`/`sector`). Projected `EASTING`/`NORTHING`/
  `POINT_X`/`POINT_Y` deliberately NOT aliased — `outSR=4326` geometry stays
  the coordinate source; native-projection fields ride `excluded_fields`.
- **Cadence** — 10 monthly `sig-ingest-camreg-*` rows staggered days 28–29
  UTC; stalbert gets no job until its rights resolve.

## Verification

**Deterministic — `make check` green** (ruff, format, mypy × 231 files,
**3308 passed / 58 skipped**, verify-gen): new P26.13 tests over committed
real fixtures (Lambeth ArcGIS, Puerto Gaitán Socrata) — alias resolution,
jurisdiction schemes, projected-coordinate exclusion, gated-source refusal;
count tests re-baselined; `sig-connectors validate` green; `cadence --check`
green; `make docs-check` green.

**Local live runs** — 10 sources, 11 captures, **31,782 claims**, 0 refusals,
0 drift; committed fetch records
`live_runs/2026-09-18_camreg_*_p2613.json`.

**Hosted — 10 jobs + 10 schedulers** (`sig-api@sha256:11a4a52c…`, Cloud Build
`2c000298`, linux/amd64 @ `1467406`; per-job upserts on the user account —
ADC corrupt as recorded since P26.8):

- All 10 executions `outcome=ok` exit 0; `claims_added` per source **exactly
  matches the local table** (10,600 / 5,532 / 1,949 / 4,851 / 1,080 / 315 /
  370 / 1,593 / 4,992 / 500 = 31,782). DC's two hosted capture digests are
  **byte-identical to the committed local fetch record**.
- **Spine:** 232,224 → **260,690** (+28,466 = 31,782 − 3,316 `traffic_camera`
  entity records — exactly one per camera, the P26.8/9 accounting shape);
  `source_registry` 46 → **56**.
- **Idempotent re-runs** (one per fetch kind): `camreg-york-gb-8r9q6` +
  `camreg-puertogaitan-co-srq5t` — identical capture digests, `claims_added`
  recomputed → **+0 new claim rows** (260,690 unchanged).
- Run rows WORM at `gs://…-sig-restricted/ops/runs/camreg_<src>/2026-09-18/`;
  10 `sig-sched-camreg-*` triggers ENABLED on the cadence crons.

## Acceptance criteria

- ≥50 candidates across ≥2 catalog APIs — **3,257 across 3**. ✓
- ≥10 qualifying datasets produce hosted-spine claims — **10**. ✓
- Ambiguous datasets gated and named — **257 + St. Albert under
  D-SOURCES.12-1**. ✓
- `make check` + build-memory green; ladder re-measured (198 / 76 / 87 /
  56). ✓
